The CityRide receipt visible in Mail was from Oct 3 (before the trip). (3) The hotel search in Mail found an 'Offsite logistics' email about a Marriott hotel block but this was for a March 15-17 offsite, not the business trip. (4) The MyBank search for 'hotel' returned no results. (5) The food categorization missed the MegaMart charge ($34.99 on Oct 9) and the Blue Bottle Coffee charge visible in the search results. (6) The total calculation ($886.93) appears incorrect given the data found. (7) The document was created in CloudDocs but with inaccurate/incomplete data. The agent did create a document and reported trip dates and expenses, but the data quality and completeness are poor.
